_comment: Diamond 4x4x4 supercell (128 atoms), LCAO: Fermi level, electron density and LDOS on a real-space grid. Real-space tasks are Gamma-only and need every cell width above twice the orbital cutoff (2 x 3.70 A). The density filter degree scales as span/kT, so a 3000 K smearing -- harmless for a 4.5 eV gap -- keeps it to minutes.
